messages.subject: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

We're looking at renting a 20kVA diesel generator for an upcoming site job. What are the delivery options? We'd need it brought out to a location in Oulu.

Thanks,
Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

Will check availability and delivery slots for the generator and come back to you.

Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi Jussi,

One more thing while we're at it. We'd like to book a 1-tonne mini dumper as well, same as our previous rental. Can you set that up?

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted on the mini dumper. I'll check what we have and get back to you.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
We have a problem with the site cabin heater you've supplied. There was a burning smell coming from it overnight and the guys on site are saying it's a fire risk. We've switched it off and disconnected it but someone needs to come look at this today. This can't wait.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy
